req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with the same body for the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: The idempotency requirement for PUT /tasks/{task_id} means that issuing the same PUT request N times must yield the same terminal state as issuing it once. To verify this we need: (1) a positive case that calls PUT twice with identical bodies and asserts both responses are identical in every field; (2) a negative case that confirms a non-existent task_id returns 404 on every repeated call; (3) a boundary case that exercises the title field at its minimum length (1 char) across repeated calls. Additional tests cover: repeated PUT on a completed task (STC), and a PUT with all optional fields set to boundary-max values repeated twice (BVA). Each test uses a fresh in-process TestClient backed by an in-memory SQLite DB seeded with the canonical 20-row fixture, ensuring determinism.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_same_body_twice_positive
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists (title='Fix login bug', completed=false)
Database is seeded with canonical 20-row fixture
actions: POST in-process TestClient for FastAPI app with in-memory SQLite
Seed task id=7 equivalent via POST
Issue PUT /tasks/{task_id} with body {title:'Updated title', description:'New desc', completed:true}
Issue identical PUT again
Compare both responses field by field
expected: Both response bodies have identical id, title, description, completed
tests.executable:
import os, sys
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

create_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Fix login bug', 'description': 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', 'completed': False})
assert create_r.status_code == 201
task_id = create_r.json()['id']

body = {'title': 'Updated title', 'description': 'New desc', 'completed': True}
r1 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=body)
r2 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=body)

assert r1.status_code == 200
assert r2.status_code == 200
d1, d2 = r1.json(), r2.json()
assert d1['id'] == d2['id'] == task_id
assert d1['title'] == d2['title'] == 'Updated title'
assert d1['description'] == d2['description'] == 'New desc'
assert d1['completed'] == d2['completed'] == True
assert d1['completed'] is True
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

assert get_r.status_code == 200
